title.narrative: International Work Group for Indigenous Affairs (IWGIA) project under Tropical Forest Initiative

description.narrative: The project aims to reduce deforestation and ecosystem degradation of targeted tropical forests through indigenous-led, sustainable forest governance, management, and protection, enhancing climate resilience, and biodiversity conservation in Colombia, Ecuador and Peru. The project proposes three interrelated outcomes: 1) Promoting stronger land tenure and self-governance rights for indigenous people, empowering them, and women within them, to take the lead in managing and protecting tropical forests. 2) Protecting and strengthening sustainable livelihoods, conservation initiatives, and climate resilience of Indigenous People through the development and implementation of plans and initiatives rooted in Indigenous knowledge and gender justice. 3) Ensuring that Indigenous People's' voices (particularly of Indigenous women) are actively included and respected in decision-making, helping to shape policies that respect their rights and foster effective forest and biodiversity management.
